hint.text:
The subjunctive form can be used in formal speech and writing. The subjunctive verb form is always the same, regardless of who it is referring to.

Informal: The Prime Minister demanded that all school dinners are free.

Formal: The Prime Minister demanded that all school dinners be free.

instruction.text: Choose the sentence that uses the subjunctive verb form.

b: ++The teacher requested that Katie be present for the lesson tomorrow.
My teacher told Katie to come to the lesson tomorrow.
Teacher said Katie can’t skip school tomorrow.
++If I were you, I would practise my spellings more.
You should really practise your spellings more.
It’s important to do spelling practise.
++Paul’s father suggested that he apologise immediately.
Paul’s father told him to say sorry asap.
Paul’s father wanted him to say sorry now.
